title: Ultraleap hands
summary: Hand tracking from an Ultraleap / Leap Motion camera as OpenXR controllers and XR_EXT_hand_tracking joints.

abi.provider_device: unversioned (raw struct xrt_device, runtime ADR-063) - the reason for runtime_range

runtime_range.rule: The binary is built at `build`. It is valid on every runtime release whose shared headers (scripts/runtime_range.py: the xrt_device / xrt_input_plugin include closure plus u_logging.h and u_var.h) are byte-identical to `build`'s. `min`..`verified_max` is the contiguous run of releases for which that was checked (CI re-checks it). A runtime newer than verified_max is UNVERIFIED, not known-bad: when one is released the check is re-run; identical -> raise verified_max here (no rebuild, no new provider release); different -> repin, rebuild, release. A catalog client should offer this component only inside the range.
runtime_range.after_adr_063: min = build pin, no maximum inside one input ABI major

The provider loads, logs 'Ultraleap tracking software NOT FOUND' with the paths it looked in, reports its hardware absent (the runtime keeps its keyboard/mouse controllers) and looks again every 5 s, so it starts working once the Ultraleap software is installed - no reinstall of this component.

notes.title: Disable Ultraleap's implicit OpenXR layer for desk use
notes.text: The Ultraleap installer registers XR_APILAYER_ULTRALEAP_hand_tracking as an implicit OpenXR API layer. The loader puts it in every OpenXR app, whichever runtime is active, and each load resets the tracking service to Head-mounted mode: with the camera on the desk the hands come back left/right swapped and sideways motion reads as depth. Set DISABLE_XR_APILAYER_ULTRALEAP_HAND_TRACKING_1=1 in the user environment, close every OpenXR app, then select Desktop mode again in the Ultraleap Control Panel.
notes.action: advise only - never change the layer's registration or the environment on the user's behalf

notes.title: LeapC is bound at run time
notes.text: Nothing of Ultraleap's is shipped or copied. The provider opens LeapC.dll by absolute path from the Ultraleap install, so another LeapC.dll on PATH is never used. Non-default install location: displayxr-cli input set ultraleap LEAPC_PATH <folder>.
